seo.title: How It Works
seo.description: Learn how VoiceBridge works — from setup to daily use. See step-by-step flows for parents, children, and therapy centers.

hero.description: VoiceBridge is designed to get out of the way and let communication happen naturally. Here's how the whole system works.

createAccount.title: Create Your Account
createAccount.description: Sign up as a parent or therapy center in under 2 minutes. No credit card required. You'll be taken directly to the setup wizard.
details: Choose parent or therapy center account type

setupProfile.title: Set Up Your Child's Profile
setupProfile.description: Add your child's name, photo, and preferred language. This personalizes the experience — the app will use your child's name in spoken phrases.

customizeBoard.title: Customize the Communication Board
customizeBoard.description: Start with our pre-built card library or build from scratch. Organize cards into categories that match your child's daily needs and routine.
details: Add custom cards with photos from your gallery
Arrange and group cards by category

childUsesBoard.title: Child Uses the Board
childUsesBoard.description: Hand the device to your child. The full-screen communication board is simple enough for them to use independently. Tapping a card speaks the phrase aloud.
details: Large colorful cards fill the screen
Child can navigate between card categories

parentsNotified.title: Parents Get Notified Instantly
parentsNotified.description: Every card tap sends an immediate push notification to all connected devices. You see your child's name and exactly what they communicated.

journeysSection.heading: User Journeys
journeysSection.description: How each person in the VoiceBridge ecosystem experiences the app.

steps: Create account → set up child profile
Acknowledge requests to close the loop
Browse and tap the card they need
See confirmation the parent was notified

cta.heading: Ready to get started?
cta.description: Set up your child's board in less than 5 minutes.
